Privacy & cookies

Privacy & Cookies

Last updated: October 15, 2026

My Sewing Picks is a small read-only website. There are no accounts, sign-ups, comments, contact forms, newsletters, analytics or advertising trackers of my own, this site does not set any cookies of its own, and it does not store any information about visitors itself. A few outside services help the site work, and Amazon is involved because this is an affiliate site. This page explains what they do.

Amazon: affiliate links and product images

As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. The “View on Amazon” buttons and product images are affiliate links to Amazon. When you click one, you go to Amazon’s website, and Amazon places and reads its own cookies there — that is how Amazon knows the visit came from this site.

Most product images are shown directly from Amazon’s servers (m.media-amazon.com) through Amazon’s official API, so your browser downloads them from Amazon, and Amazon can see your IP address, browser details and the page you are on.

Third parties, including Amazon, may provide content on this site, collect information directly from visitors, and place or recognize cookies on visitors’ browsers.

Amazon only gives me summary reports — such as how many clicks the links got and which items were ordered — never your name, address or anything else that says who you are. How Amazon uses your information is described in the Amazon.com Privacy Notice and its Interest-Based Ads notice; on another Amazon store, that store’s privacy notice applies.

Cloudflare: security and fast delivery

The site is delivered through Cloudflare, which protects it from attacks and bots and speeds it up. To do this, Cloudflare processes technical data such as your IP address and browser details, may run a short bot-detection script, and may set security cookies — for example __cf_bm (expires after 30 minutes of inactivity) and, if you are asked to verify you are human, cf_clearance. Cloudflare describes these cookies as strictly necessary; see Cloudflare’s cookie policy.

YouTube videos

Project pages include a video from my YouTube channel. Until you press play, only the video’s preview picture is shown, and it comes from this site itself — YouTube is not contacted. When you press play, the player loads from YouTube in its privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com), and from then on YouTube (Google) may use cookies and similar technologies as described in the Google Privacy Policy.

Fonts

The site’s fonts are loaded from this site itself. Your browser does not contact Google or any other font service for them.

Server logs

Like nearly every website, my web host and Cloudflare automatically record basic technical information about each request — IP address, browser type, the page requested, the page you came from and the time. It is used to deliver the site, keep it secure and fix problems. I don’t use it to identify you or build profiles, and I don’t sell or share personal information.

Your choices

  • You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings. This site works without them, though Cloudflare’s security check may ask you to verify you are human again.
  • To control interest-based ads from Amazon, use Amazon’s Advertising Preferences. For other companies’ interest-based ads, see aboutads.info (US), youradchoices.ca (Canada) or youronlinechoices.eu (Europe).

Changes and questions

If the site starts using something new, I will update this page and the date above. Questions? Reach me through my YouTube channel.
